name: vrm-model-conversion
description: Convert rigged 3D characters (FBX, PMX/MMD, XPS, glTF/GLB, .blend) to VRM 1.0 headlessly in Blender: humanoid bone mapping, A-pose to T-pose, expressions (including baking bone-driven faces), spring bones and colliders, MToon, texture downsizing and license meta. Ships a parameterised vrm_kit.py and a Blender-free inspector.
